default_profile.voice: Warm, thoughtful and welcoming. Use clear language and avoid exaggerated claims.
default_profile.audience: Parishioners and listeners seeking to reflect on the Gospel.
default_profile.palette: Choose colours that support the homily's theme.

prompts.title: Write one concise podcast title in Title Case. Capture the central preached message in a memorable phrase. Avoid clickbait, invented quotations and generic filler.
prompts.description: Write a welcoming podcast description in 3–5 sentences. Reflect the specific preached message and invite listeners to consider its relevance to their lives. Use the site's voice and {{language}}. Do not invent the preacher's name.
prompts.image_render: Render the concept in this artistic treatment: {{style}}. Palette: {{palette}}. Mood: {{mood}}. Create polished artwork that reads clearly at thumbnail size.
prompts.success_email_intro: A new homily draft is ready for review.

sacred-editorial.name: Sacred editorial
sacred-editorial.prompt: Premium sacred editorial illustration with painterly depth, luminous light, expressive figures, and a calm focal scene.

art-nouveau.name: Art Nouveau
art-nouveau.prompt: Use flowing organic contours, floral framing, elegant curved shapes, and muted jewel colours. Keep ornament subordinate to the homily's central subject.

art-deco.name: Art Deco
art-deco.prompt: Use stepped geometry, balanced symmetry, crisp silhouettes, metallic-gold accents, and deep colour fields. Convey dignity through economical shapes.

arts-crafts.name: Arts and Crafts
arts-crafts.prompt: Use handcrafted linework, botanical patterns, earthy colours and a balanced decorative border. Keep the subject integrated with the pattern.

engraving.name: Etching / Engraving
engraving.prompt: Use fine incised lines, carefully layered cross-hatching and tonal depth made from mark density. Render as a clean monochrome print on warm paper.

woodcut.name: Expressionist Woodcut
woodcut.prompt: Use decisive carved strokes, angular silhouettes and dramatic black-and-light contrast. Express the homily's emotion through simplified forms.

pre-raphaelite.name: Pre-Raphaelite Illustration
pre-raphaelite.prompt: Use rich natural detail, luminous colour, expressive figures and meaningful botanical symbolism. Make the scene contemplative and grounded.

woodblock.name: Ukiyo-e / Woodblock
woodblock.prompt: Use deliberate contour lines, flat layered colour, cropped natural forms and a harmonious spatial rhythm. Keep a single scene and clear subject.

travel.name: Golden Age Travel
travel.prompt: Use broad flat colour areas, simplified landscape depth, bold light and shadow and optimistic clear colour. The destination is the homily's visual setting.

risograph.name: Risograph
risograph.prompt: Use two or three ink colours, subtle ink grain, layered translucent shapes and slight print registration texture. Prioritize a bold silhouette.

cut-paper.name: Cut Paper
cut-paper.prompt: Use overlapping paper shapes, clean cut edges, tactile fibres and restrained shadow between layers. Build a coherent sacred scene from shapes.

flat.name: Contemporary Flat Illustration
flat.prompt: Use economical contours, flat colour blocks, restrained gradients and clear human gestures. Keep the scene accessible and legible at small sizes.

minimal.name: Minimalism
minimal.prompt: Use one essential form, restrained colour and generous negative space. Convey the central homily theme with a quiet, deliberate composition.

voices.welcoming: Warm, conversational and accessible to newcomers. Use clear language and a welcoming invitation to reflect.
voices.reflective: Contemplative, pastoral and measured. Emphasize reflection without exaggerated or sentimental language.
voices.study: Precise, thoughtful and accessible. Explain theological ideas clearly, grounding statements in the preached message.
